about: ADR 0153 / ADR 0167 / ADR 0218: the only hosts the module installer may reach, on consent. Since 0.3.0 the package host is the GitHub release modules-index of qrtz-ai/qrtz (flat asset names, module_hosting::flat_asset_name; redirects only to GitHub asset hosts), with Cloudflare R2 behind modules.qrtz.ai as the fallback mirror until it is shut down. root1Sha256 pins v1/root/1.root.json (root 1 from scripts/modules/release-keys.sh, 2026-10-18; threshold 2, both root keys; a public copy with its .sig is checked in at crates/qrtz-modules/roots/ and served at https://modules.qrtz.ai/v1/root/1.root.json). Were it null, every network install would be refused. modelMirrors are the only hosts a signed tree's mirror URL may point at, and since ADR 0171 the only place a model file is fetched from: its pinned Hugging Face URL (a commit, never main), checked by the signed sha256 and size through the same fetcher; modules.qrtz.ai serves packages, roots, the index and the timestamp, never model bytes. crates/qrtz-lifecycle/tests/offline_graph.rs checks this file.
